title: Consistency is a kindness
headline: Consistency is a kindness to your future self
caption:
The clocks have gone back, and the evenings are dark by teatime. 🌙

This is the week a lot of good routines quietly slip.

It doesn't take a big push to keep going. One class a week, booked in ahead, is enough to carry you through to spring feeling stronger than you do today.

Future you will thank you for every one of those hours.

If you're looking for reformer Pilates in the Ribble Valley, there's a warm, welcoming spot waiting for you here, whatever your level.

Book your next class through the link in our bio.

📍 POWR Studio, 9 York Street, Clitheroe
